title: ContextOS Configuration
description: ContextOS configuration: ~/.contextos/config.json globally, with per-project overrides in ~/.contextos/projects/<project-id>/config.json. Legacy project .contextos/config.json is read for compatibility.

dbPath.description: Selected project/worktree view database, managed by the registry under ~/.contextos/projects/<project-id>/views/<view-id>/index.db. Legacy project .contextos/index.db is a migration source.

globalContextDir.description: Legacy source-directory setting retained for configuration compatibility. Shared indexed content is read from ~/.contextos/index.db; the workspace server does not automatically scan this directory. Legacy default: ~/.contextos/global.

indexablePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to index.

ignorePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to ignore, in addition to safety exclusions and the project root .gitignore and .contextosignore files.

maxChunkTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens per chunk.

maxSymbolChunkTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens per symbol chunk before splitting.

maxRetrievalResults.description: Maximum number of raw results to retrieve before filtering.

maxTokenBudget.description: Target token budget for retrieval responses.

maxExactTokenBudget.description: Hard upper token limit applied after exact token counting. Retrieval results are clamped to this budget.

graphExpansionMaxNodes.description: Max nodes to retrieve via graph expansion.

maxGraphBoost.description: Maximum boost score from graph edges.

embeddingsEnabled.description: Whether to generate and store embeddings.

embeddingsRetrieval.description: Whether to fuse embedding kNN into retrieval.

memoryInjection.description: How global memory facts are injected.

adaptiveResponse.description: Reserved compatibility setting. The workspace server uses the request tier and token budgets instead.

execAllowRepoScripts.description: Allow ctx_execute to run the repository's own scripts (npm/npx). Default false; enable only for trusted repositories.
